create_smoothedvalue_tracker: create a SmoothedValue instance to track a rolling window of metric values with configurable window size
update_smoothedvalue: update a SmoothedValue with a new value and batch size to compute median, avg, and global_avg
create_meter_for_metrics: create a Meter instance to aggregate and track multiple SmoothedValue metrics across training batches
update_meter_from_report: update a Meter from a Report object containing losses and metrics for the current batch
get_meter_log_dict: get a formatted log dictionary from a Meter with median and global average values for logging
